invariants: all destinations are known before the first target write
all candidates validate in scratch before publication
all locks are acquired in sorted canonical path order
every preimage and parent identity is revalidated before the first publication
every published target has a durable exact rollback pointer first
a later target failure restores every earlier published target and verifies each digest
final verification reopens every target and checks cross-file revision consistency
nonGoals: shell string as the authoring protocol
